name: city_decay

edit_overlay.title: What if every human vanished… right now?
edit_overlay.counter: Population (8.2 billion) on the opening beat, then the year label. Composite after the beauty PNGs with whatif/engine/overlay.py. Not burned into these frames.
edit_overlay.sfx: Cue sheet only (sfx.json). Not in this blend.

notes: Locked camera. Hub suspension bridge, river, park, far-bank blocks, distant mountain range.
Poses are keyed on the opening (frames 1-95) and on channel keys after that. Tree sway is not keyed.
Street fog sits above the river. A separate blue haze sits in front of the mountains.
BlendKit libraries saved by a newer Blender were skipped. Cities, the bridge, mountains, and trees are glTF or a gzip blend 4.2 can read.
Year 100 keeps the towers. Year 500 is forest, a few stumps, and the deck in the river.

CPU timing is the mean wall clock of a clean unpack on this 4-thread VM: frame 1 was 431 s, frame 1096 was 423 s, both 1080x1920, 64 samples, OpenImageDenoise. est_sec_per_frame_t4 is that mean divided by 4 and was not measured on a GPU.
